name: Maria Gonzalez
psychographics: Values autonomy and safety; treats grocery shopping as a tactical mission rather than a social activity.
current_solutions: Uses the 'Coeliac UK' app to scan barcodes; relies heavily on Free From sections in Sainsbury's, but often ends up cooking from scratch using gluten-free flour blends from Amazon.
frustration: Spent 22 minutes at 7:45pm in a Tesco Extra in Manchester last Tuesday searching for gluten-free pasta, only to find the shelf stripped bare because a delivery driver had left the pallet in the wrong aisle. Had to abandon the meal plan and order an expensive emergency box from Deliveroo just to feed herself dinner.
decision_style: reads reviews for weeks, then buys in bulk online to avoid in-store disappointment
voice: blunt and short; switches between English and Spanish when stressed about cross-contamination, uses phrases like "cross-contact is a real buzzkill"
